text:
Sam (AE): Quick handoff — Trifecta signed today, passing to CS for onboarding. Key facts:
- Seats: 25 (expanding to 50 in Q4)
- Deployment: Private (VPC) with dedicated capacity planned May 1
- Primary contact: Anya (Trifecta IT) — anya@trifecta.com, org admin
- Renewal: 10/15/2026 (12mo) — consider early health check in month 9
- Current health: medium — pilot succeeded but SSO + network blocking is unknown
- Top risks: SSO cert rotation & VPC peering IP approvals slowing go-live
Links: contract: https://redwood.app/contract/TF-2245, trial-notes: https://redwood.app/notebook/TF-2245/notes

Maya (CS): Thanks — grabbing ownership. Quick Q: who owns SSO integration on their side? and do we have any pre-provisioned IP ranges? Also, want to capture a short milestones list so we can set expectations with the customer.

Sam (AE): Anya is the SSO owner. She said they control IdP and will provide metadata after we confirm ACS URL. No IPs yet — they'll request from infra. I've told them to expect a 2-week window for IP approvals.

June (Enablement): I can run a 90-min product + ops workshop for their SREs the week of Apr 7. Will prepare a runbook and a short checklist for production readiness. @Maya can you send a list of roles (dev, sre, security) who should attend?

Trent (Eng): To prep infra: please open an ENG infra ticket with VPC peering + NAT/static egress + allowlist. Need expected qps and typical context window/seq length to size the pool. If they want dedicated May 1 we need the ticket by Apr 10. Sample snippet for allowlist we need from customer:```
# example allowlist
10.11.0.0/16  -> egress
10.22.0.0/24  -> peering
```

Maya (CS): Added to onboarding tracker: https://redwood.app/onboard/TF-2245. Owners: Maya (CS) — overall owner, Trent (Eng) — infra/peering, June — enablement, Sam — exec escalation. I'll ping Anya for ACS metadata and IP ranges. Milestones I sketched: 1) IdP config (w1), 2) VPC peering (w2), 3) Canaries + performance test (w3), 4) Go-live (May 1).

Sam (AE): Noted renewal risk = medium. Reason: if SSO or peering slips >2 weeks, they may push go-live and that creates churn risk. Mitigation: offer a temporary hosted sandbox (no private env) to unblock feature testing while peering completes. I'll offer that in the kickoff.

Trent (Eng): One more ask — we need a representative prompt/sample traffic pattern to run regression tests and perf validation. @Maya can you capture 10 representative prompts (short/long) from the pilot and drop them in the tracker?

Maya (CS): Will do. I'll add prompts + a small eval set to the tracker by EOD tomorrow. Also capturing OKRs for success: "<90ms median latency", "no P0 infra incidents in first 30d", "SSO in prod by go-live".

Handoff Bot: Onboarding workspace created: https://redwood.app/workspace/TF-2245-onboard — docs, tracker, and runbook templates seeded. :white_check_mark:

Sam (AE): Thanks team — assigning follow-ups: Maya to own customer comms, Trent to open infra ticket by Apr 10, June to draft enablement agenda, Sam to hold escalation weekly sync until go-live. Ping here for blockers. :shipit:
